name: Data Preview Depricarping
implementation_notes: Dual-mode component (list/detail driven by :id? route param), mirrors DataPreviewPressingView.vue's watch()-driven mode switch exactly

Detail mode renders the Depricarping Detail grid read-only straight from stored columns (no recomputation, historical data), however many rows the record actually has (REVISED 2026-08-24: no longer always 24 -- this screen required NO functional code change for the entity-catalog v12 dynamic-add-row revision, since it already rendered `details.length` rows directly and already had an empty-state for zero rows) plus the same static 4-column Target Operasional reference table used by Form Depricarping (screen-043)
Checked By/Acknowledged By rendered read-only with no role restriction on viewing, consistent with Data Preview Threshing/Pressing and this screen's business spec

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec (mobile/tests/e2e/data-preview-depricarping.spec.ts) was originally authored for the fixed-24-row design, then REVISED 2026-08-24 alongside this fix to seed only 3 depricarping_detail rows (matching what a real saved record now typically looks like) -- still could not be executed in this sandboxed environment against a running dev server + seeded backend, verified only by static review.
